reverse-string.title: Reverse a String
reverse-string.description: Given a string, print it reversed. For example, the string "hello" should print "olleh".

fizzbuzz.title: FizzBuzz (1 to 5)
fizzbuzz.description: For each number from 1 to 5, print the number — except print "Fizz" for multiples of 3, "Buzz" for multiples of 5, and "FizzBuzz" for multiples of both 3 and 5.

palindrome-check.title: Palindrome Check
palindrome-check.description: Given a word, print "true" if it reads the same forwards and backwards (ignoring case), otherwise print "false". Check the word "racecar".

count-vowels.title: Count Vowels
count-vowels.description: Count how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in a word and print the number. Check the word "programming".

sum-even-numbers.title: Sum of Even Numbers
sum-even-numbers.description: Given an array of numbers, print the sum of only the even numbers. For [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] the answer is 12.

two-sum.title: Two Sum
two-sum.description: Given an array of numbers and a target sum, print the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target, separated by a space. Exactly one solution exists. For [2, 7, 11, 15] with target 9, the answer is "0 1".

factorial.title: Factorial
factorial.description: Given a number n, print its factorial (n! = 1 × 2 × ... × n). The factorial of 0 is 1. Compute the factorial of 5.
